content.heroTitle: Clear vision, unhurried care, and frames that feel like you.
content.heroBody: Comprehensive eye examinations, prescription eyewear and contact lens fittings across three branches — with optometrists who take the time to explain your options.
content.aboutBody:
Choosing eyewear is about more than picking a frame. We begin with a thorough examination, explain what we find in plain language, and help you weigh lens and frame options against how you actually live — screens, sport, driving, reading.

From the first check to the final fitting, every visit is meant to feel considered and never rushed.

values.title: Thorough eye exams
values.body: Refraction, eye-health screening and a clear explanation of your prescription.

values.title: Honest guidance
values.body: Lens and frame recommendations that fit your needs and budget.

values.title: Made-to-measure lenses
values.body: Single vision, progressives and specialty lenses from our partner laboratory.

values.title: Aftercare included
values.body: Free adjustments and fit checks for the life of your frames.

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment for an eye exam?
faqs.answer: Walk-ins are welcome when an optometrist is free, but booking guarantees your slot. Comprehensive exams take about 45 minutes.

faqs.question: How long do prescription glasses take?
faqs.answer: Most single-vision orders are ready in 3–5 days. Progressive and specialty lenses take 5–7 days because they're made to measure at our partner laboratory.

faqs.question: Can I bring a prescription from another clinic?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bring your written prescription (ideally less than a year old) and we'll fit lenses to it. We may recommend a quick check if it's older.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Cash, credit and debit cards, bank transfer, GCash and Maya. Orders can be reserved with a deposit and settled at pickup.

faqs.question: Do you fit contact lenses for first-time wearers?
faqs.answer: Yes. A contact lens consultation includes measurements, trial lenses and a lesson on safe handling and care.

faqs.question: Is there a warranty on frames?
faqs.answer: Frames carry a 6-month warranty against manufacturing defects, and adjustments are always free.
